scope: Actual GPU refinement of the supplied Lego video and explicit animated Blender source geometry. Extra-angle RGB checks are source consistency measurements, not captured multi-camera reconstruction.
limitations: Final detail stage fits geometry at all 399 source times; same-time geometry checks are production-fit diagnostics, not independent held-out-time validation.
Approximate orbit bucket masks are not exact semantic occlusion masks.
Per-piece diagnostics cover visible parts only; aggregate improvements do not imply every piece improved.
Offline video FPS and single-process render timing do not guarantee browser/SSH playback FPS.
